Take a 20-second video: press the dim button so it visibly responds, while the display stays black and no on-device menu appears. That single clip is the whole case.
Email happycustomer@viture.us. Order 113-4307365-6229868. Attach the video. Say: powers on, dim button responds, zero video output, no on-device menu with no source attached.
Include the three log lines: DP alt mode negotiated, HPD asserted, sinkCount 0. Says the fault is inside the glasses, not the host.
Say the tests are already done: HDMI via KIHENG, multiple hosts, both cable orientations. All black. Kills the "your computer does not support DP alt mode" reply.
Ask directly whether there is a display-side recovery flash or reset combo. The web updater only reaches the USB branch.
Expect a reply in 1-2 business days, and up to 7 days for the claim decision.
When they send an address: ORIGINAL PACKAGING and a TRACKABLE method, both required. You are in Canada until the 23rd, so ship from there rather than from Guatemala.
